title: 自動販賣機投幣
question:
你身上有一些 50 元、10 元、5 元硬幣，要剛好投 x 元買飲料。第一行輸入 50 元、10 元、5 元各有幾枚，第二行輸入 x，輸出有幾種投法。
想想看：其實知道 50 元和 10 元各投幾枚之後，5 元要幾枚就能算出來，可以少一層迴圈嗎？

en.title: Vending Machine Coins
en.question:
You have some 50, 10, and 5 dollar coins. You need to pay exactly x dollars for a drink. The first line is how many 50, 10 and 5 dollar coins you have. The second line is x. Output how many ways you can pay.
Think: once you know how many 50s and 10s you use, you can work out the 5s. Can you use one less loop?
